# SYNTHETIC revenue-cycle data: parameters (invented)

**Everything in this folder is SYNTHETIC.** It was generated by `src/sifpa/rcm/generate.py` (seed 7).
It exists only to exercise the RCM KPI logic (`sql/rcm/*.sql` and the `RCM (SYNTHETIC)` DAX measures).
It says nothing about the operator or any real practice, and the memo draws no conclusion from it.

| Parameter | Value (invented) |
|---|---|
| Claims | 5,000 infusion claims, service dates 2026-01-01..2026-09-29, as-of 2026-09-30 |
| Payer mix | Medicare FFS 20%, Medicare Advantage 22%, Commercial 50%, Medicaid 8% |
| First-pass denial probability | FFS 6%, MA 14%, Commercial 12%, Medicaid 16% |
| Median days to pay | FFS 14, MA 30, Commercial 35, Medicaid 45 (gamma-distributed) |
| Denial reason mix (CARC group) | Authorization 30%, Eligibility 22%, Coding 18%, Medical necessity 14%, Missing info 10%, Timely filing/duplicate 6% |
| Overturn on appeal | 55% / 35% / 60% / 40% / 80% / 5% by group |
| Scrubber edit (not clean) | 8% |
| Patient responsibility | 12% of allowed; 70% collected |
| Expected allowed per claim | lognormal, mean $3,200 x payer contract multiple (0.85-1.25) |

KPI definitions are in `sql/rcm/`. Each comes with a DAX twin in `powerbi/.../tables/*.tmdl`.
